transcript.content: Hi, I'm trying to get some information about my flight tomorrow and was wondering if you could tell me when online check-in opens, as well as when I need to be at the airport and when the gate closes?
Thank you for calling Sky Airways customer service. My name is Sky, and I'm here to help you today. How can I assist you?

Hi Sky, my name is Emily Wilson, and I'm actually flying with you tomorrow on flight SKY123 from London to Paris. Could you please let me know when online check-in opens so I can get that sorted out for my journey?
I can certainly help you with that. I'll just need a moment to look up our check-in policies for you.

No worries at all, Sky. We're actually arriving in London tomorrow morning and I'm planning to get some work done before my flight. Could you also let me know what time I should aim to arrive at the airport, please? And if there's a way to check the status of our specific flight without checking online check-in yet?
Sorry Sky, it looks like your line dropped out. Could you repeat what you just said about the airport arrival time and checking the status of our flight? I didn't quite catch it.

Online check-in for your flight opens 48 hours before departure and closes 2 hours before departure. Regarding your arrival at the airport, I recommend arriving at least 3 hours before your scheduled departure time, especially if you have bags to check. This allows ample time for check-in, bag drop, and security, as gates close 15 minutes before departure.

To check the status of your specific flight, I can use our flight status tool. Could you please provide me with your flight number?

That sounds helpful, thanks Sky. My flight number is SKY123 and it's actually scheduled to depart at 10:30am tomorrow, so that would be around 3 hours before departure. Would I be able to check the status of my specific flight on your website or through this call?
I am sorry, but I cannot find any information for flight SKY123. Could you please double-check the flight number?

I've rechecked it, and I'm almost certain it's SKY123. Let me try again, can you check the system, Sky? My booking reference is B123456, and I booked my ticket a few weeks ago. Could that help you locate my flight?
I am sorry, but I cannot find a booking with the reference B123456. Could you please double-check the reference number?

I've rechecked it, and I'm pretty sure it's correct. I did receive an email confirmation from Sky Airways when I booked, which included the flight details, including the booking reference. Would it be possible for you to look up my booking again or check with your team to see if there's any record of a passenger with that reference?

I understand you've rechecked the booking reference, but unfortunately, my system is still showing that booking B123456 cannot be found. Could you please double-check the booking reference in your confirmation email one more time? Sometimes a small typo can make a difference.

I'll go check again... (pause) Ah, yes, I have it here. My confirmation email shows that my booking reference is actually B1234567, not B123456. Could you please try looking up the flight with this new information, Sky?
I am sorry, but I still cannot find a booking with the reference B1234567. Could you please double-check the reference number from your confirmation email once more?

I'm going to check again... (pause) Okay, it's definitely B1234567. I've got it right this time, I'm sure of it. Can you please just try one more time to look up my flight with that reference, Sky? I'd really appreciate it if we could figure this out.

I understand you're certain about the booking reference B1234567, but unfortunately, I am still unable to find any booking associated with that reference in our system. It's possible there might be a slight discrepancy or a different format.

Could you perhaps provide the exact flight number for your flight tomorrow, or the full names of the passengers on the booking? This might help me locate your reservation through an alternative method.

I understand that it's possible there's a discrepancy. I'll try to recall everything... (pause) Okay, my flight number is SKY123, and the full names of the passengers on the booking are Emily Wilson and her companion, David Lee. We're both traveling together. Is there any chance that you might be able to look up our reservation through an alternative method?

I am sorry, but I am still unable to find any flight information for SKY123, and I cannot locate a booking with the reference B1234567. Unfortunately, I am also unable to search for bookings using passenger names. It seems there might be an issue with the flight number or booking reference you have.

I'm so sorry to hear that, Sky. I've double-checked everything and I'm really sure it's SKY123 and B1234567. I'd appreciate it if you could escalate this issue to a supervisor or someone who might be able to help me find my flight. Can I please speak with someone else now?

I understand your frustration, and I apologize that I haven't been able to locate your flight with the information provided. As an AI assistant, I am unable to transfer you to a supervisor.

However, I can suggest that you try contacting Sky Airways directly through our official website or customer service line, as they may have alternative methods to assist you with your booking. They might be able to look up your reservation using different details.

That sounds like a good idea, thank you for suggesting that. I'll try contacting Sky Airways directly through their website and see if they can help me find my flight. Is there anything else I can provide to support my request, or is there anything else you'd recommend I do in the meantime?

I recommend having your flight number, booking reference, and the full names of the passengers ready when you contact Sky Airways directly. Also, please double-check your email for the original booking confirmation, as it should contain all the accurate details. Is there anything else I can assist you with regarding Sky Airways today?
